Function: Host that reads the module on I2C and writes state.json
Operating voltage: 5 V logic from pin 2; I2C and UART signals are 3.3 V
Connection: pin 2 5 V logic, pin 6 GND, pin 3 I2C1_SDA, pin 5 I2C1_SCL. UART pins 8 and 10 are optional and unused
Notes: I2C is /dev/i2c-7. sudo i2cdetect -y -r 7 should show 0x45. UART /dev/ttyTHS0 is optional and disabled. Do not put pack voltage on a header pin. Do not use pin 1 (3.3 V) or pin 4 for the module. Pin 1 is the header end nearest the USB and Ethernet ports; pins 39 and 40 are toward the fan. Meter: pin 1 is 3.3 V and pin 2 is 5 V. Header I2C is 3.3 V and not 5 V tolerant. If Matek SDA idle is above about 3.6 V, use a BSS138 level shifter. Jetson power is outside this monitor

Operating voltage: logic 4-9 V on the 5V pin; bus 0-85 V
Connection: BAT+ battery, ESC+ load, JST-GH-4P 5V SCL SDA G to J12 pins 2 5 3 6
Notes: Address 0x45 (decimal 69) with jumpers open. Also 0x44 and 0x41. Conductive path 200 µΩ typical. Driver accepts DEVICE_ID 0x2281 only. Which of INA228 or INA238 is fitted is unverified until that register is read. I2C pull-up rail is unverified: measure SDA idle before connecting. Above about 3.6 V, use a BSS138 level shifter

Manufacturer / model: Volton (볼턴) 12 V 45 Ah lithium-ion LG cells
Operating voltage: 12.0 V nominal. max 12.6 V and min 9.0 V assumed for 3S Li-ion; verify with a meter at full charge
Connection: red and black leads and DC barrel connectors; small BMS box. Gauge to BAT+ and ESC+ is not chosen
Notes: Chemistry li-ion, nominal 12.0 V, capacity 45 Ah, LG cells per the Volton listing. cell_configuration 3S. max 12.6 V and min 9.0 V are assumed for 3S Li-ion; verify with a meter at full charge. Charge and discharge current stay null. Charge with a 12.6 V CC/CV Li-ion charger (Volton's own charger), not a plain 12 V power adapter.

Connection: PLA or PETG, M3 through the case tabs, no screws through the PCB
Notes: Base with tabs 49.8 x 26.8 x 10.0 mm. Body 33.8 x 26.8 x 11.8 mm. Lid print 33.8 x 26.8 x 4.2 mm. See battery/enclosure/README.md

Connection: 5V to J12 pin 2, SCL to pin 5, SDA to pin 3, G to pin 6
